_comment: Copy this file to config.json (it's gitignored) and fill in real values if the defaults don't fit. config.json is read fresh on every request, so editing it takes effect immediately without a restart. Every field here is optional — sane defaults kick in for anything left blank.
_comment_buildImage: Name/tag of the Docker image used to build the APK. Build it once with `docker build -t apk-builder-android docker/android-build` (see README). Default: apk-builder-android:latest.
_comment_buildTimeoutMinutes: Maximum time a single build container is allowed to run before it's killed and the job is marked failed. Default: 20.
_comment_retentionMinutes: How long an uploaded project, its build output, and the generated APK are kept on disk after a build finishes (success or failure) before being permanently deleted. Default: 5.
_comment_dockerBin: Path to the docker executable, if it's not on PATH under the plain name 'docker'. Default: docker.
_comment_workspaceRoot: Directory where per-job upload/output folders are created and later deleted. Default: a dedicated subfolder under the OS temp dir. Only change this if you also set hostWorkspaceRoot below.
_comment_hostWorkspaceRoot: Only needed if THIS SERVER ITSELF also runs inside a Docker container with /var/run/docker.sock bind-mounted in, so it can launch build containers as siblings (Docker-out-of-Docker). In that setup, the paths this server passes to `docker run -v` must be paths the HOST's Docker daemon can see, not paths inside this server's own container. Set workspaceRoot above to the path where you bind-mount a host directory INTO this server's container, and set hostWorkspaceRoot to that same directory's path ON THE HOST. Leave both blank if this server runs directly on the same host as the Docker daemon (a bare VPS/local machine, not itself containerized) — the recommended, simplest setup, needing no translation at all.
_comment_port: Which port the server listens on (node server/index.js / npm start / the Dockerfile's CMD). Not used on Vercel, which calls api/index.js per-request instead of running a long-lived listener — and which can't run Docker builds at all, see README. Leave blank for the default, 3000.
